definitionZh: 主流基线 CSS 属性指定了用于对齐框文本和内含级内容的具体基线。 它还表示在框的对齐上下文中参加基线对齐的任何框的默认对齐基线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.
sourceDefinition: The dominant-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. It also indicates the default alignment baseline of any boxes participating in baseline alignment in the box's alignment context. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
